context: Fix this in the skill-sync implementation using BenchBox as a regression fixture. Define each readiness dimension explicitly, honor ignore semantics consistently, detect instruction-only consumers accurately, preserve machine-readable output where possible, and document aggregate exit behavior.
description: The audit found contradictory skill-sync signals in BenchBox: verify passes the tracked Claude snapshot while status and doctor report every Codex, Gemini, and Antigravity skill missing; an intentionally ignored Claude blog skill is also reported missing; and Copilot is reported unconfigured even though repository instructions support AGENTS.md. The CLI must distinguish tracked snapshot integrity, local materialization readiness, and whole-project cross-agent readiness so a green command cannot be over-interpreted.

anti_patterns.dont: Auto-sync missing targets from status or doctor
anti_patterns.why: A diagnostic command must not mutate agent configuration

anti_patterns.dont: Make verify imply that every configured local target exists
anti_patterns.instead: Expose and name the dimensions separately
anti_patterns.why: Tracked snapshot integrity and local readiness are different claims

preserves.behavior: JSON output remains machine-readable and backward-compatible, or introduces an explicit schema version
status and doctor remain read-only and never materialize absent targets
verify continues to prove tracked target bytes against the lock and configuration
